meta.name: Honey & royal jelly
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Moderate for natural honey, thin for royal jelly. TradeKey and go4WorldBusiness show a steady 2025-2026 stream of honey buy-leads across the USA, UK, France, Malaysia, Afghanistan, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Spain, Greece, Norway, Zimbabwe, Nigeria and the Maldives — but most are small-volume, gated/anonymous contacts, or origin-locked to non-Iranian honey (Manuka/NZ, Kyrgyz, Trinidad). Royal jelly demand is genuinely thin: few named importers (Beetopia in South Korea is the standout), mostly gated or undated, and buyers typically prefer Vietnam/China origin. Best realistic fit for Iranian origin is regional/neighboring buyers (Afghanistan, the Gulf, Central Asia, Maldives) rather than premium Western markets.
